text:
mika: quick ping — i've been sketching a probe-budget controller to cap probe fanout per-request. goal: keep average probes < 6 while preserving correctness for tiered SLAs.
raj: nice. how does it interact with runtime hints?
mika: two layers: 1) runtime hint does coarse pruning 2) probe-budget enforces a max candidate count before probing. budget computed from SLA, tenant weight, and cache hits.
emily: curious about fairness — won't aggressive budgets penalize bursty tenants?
mika: budget = base_budget * tenant_multiplier. multiplier scales down when recent probe_success_rate is low. adds per-tenant smoothing window.
tran: what about critical requests that need hedging? can we override budget?
raj: we should add a priority pin: hedged_requests bypass budget but increment a global hedging_quota to stop abuse.
mika: yep. plan: add flags: `allow_huge_budget` for internal service accounts + `hedge_quota` on runtime.
emily: rollout sensors? need metrics to prove it's safe.
mika: metrics: probes_per_request, budget_hits, hedged_bypass_count, downstream_latency_delta, cost_delta. also `exhaustive_fallthroughs` when budget caused all viable routes to be trimmed.
tran: "exhaustive_fallthroughs" seems critical. if we ever see >0.1% we rollback.
raj: how to decide budget default? we have historical probe distribution — maybe P90 ~8, median 3. choose default 6 with tenant opt-in for higher.
emily: simulation: run offline replay for 72h of traffic with shadow budget enforcement to measure route loss & cost.
mika: agree. also thinking about compact hint encoding to keep runtime blob tiny. proto: `t:tenant_id,m:model_fam,s:sla,r:region_pref,vt:variant_tag?` small tokens. runtime decoders must be versioned.
tran: versioning matters. add `hint_schema_v` and signed snapshot id to the hint payload. runtime rejects unknown schema.
raj: what about policy deltas? instead of shipping full snapshots each change we can push delta patches to edge to reduce churn.
emily: deltas complicate signature verification. need an apply-seq + base-hash to validate final state. ops will need playbook for broken delta sequences.
mika: agreed. include `delta_seq` and `base_hash` in snapshot metadata. runtime keeps last known base_hash. if mismatch -> refuse delta -> request full snapshot.
tran: ops note: provide kill-switch endpoint and `runtime.hints.force_allow_all` for emergencies.
deploy-bot: deploy-check: ensure canary has 100% trace sampling and `budget_shadow_mode` enabled for 48h before enforcement.
raj: small API example for RFC:
```
POST /v1/runtime/evaluate_hint
body: {"tenant":"t-123","model":"gptx","sla":"p50-50ms","region":"us-west","hint_schema_v":2}
returns: {"candidates":["r1","r4"],"reason_codes":["region_match","tier_ok"],"snapshot_id":"s-2024-07-12"}
```

emily: please include a `debug` flag to return full candidate list in shadow runs. oncall will need that.
mika: will add. i'll write the RFC with simulation plan, metrics dashboard mockups, and staged rollout: shadow -> small canary tenants -> broader canary -> global. target architecture sync next Wednesday.
raj: thanks. one last: add `false_positive_filter` metric when budget + hint removed all valid compiled routes — must be near zero.
tran: noted. thanks everyone.
